name: Sentura Experience Extraction
description: Capability #13 Tier 3 — observes completed agent tasks via after_tool_call + agent_end hooks, scores recurring tool-sequence patterns, and promotes high-confidence patterns into the target agent's ekg/workflows/experience-links/ pillar.

candidatesDir.description: Directory for per-agent candidate stores. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-experience-extraction/

minOccurrences.description: Minimum occurrences before a pattern can be promoted to an experience-link

confidenceThreshold.description: Confidence floor for promotion (matches qa-completion + capability-extraction conventions)

workspaceRoot.description: Root for target agent workspaces (where promoted experience-links land). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/
